|lore=Anzati assassin. Cheek-folds hide proboscises which allow him to 'eat the soup' (consume the life Force) of his victims. Smokes t'bac. Currently working for Jabba.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Dannik Jerriko (Revised)]] (September 1998).
